description: Insert one or more records into a data file. For single insert, use record. For batch insert (up to 1000), use records. All records are validated before any writes — invalid batch = no partial writes.

record.description: JSON object of a single record to insert, e.g. {"name": "foo", "status": "active"}. Use this OR records, not both.

records.description: JSON array of records for batch insert (max 1000), e.g. [{"name": "foo"}, {"name": "bar"}]. Use this OR record, not both.

userid.description: Project owner's username. Required when accessing a shared project where you are a writer. Defaults to the authenticated user.

name: chaprola_insert_record
